purpose: Sample: repaint the 16 older Christian films reused in wave 1 so each has its own look (owner: "We can't have the same look for every film").
rules: no two Christian month-one films within 5 days of each other share a look (new or reused)
each shot keeps its story beat and framing from the existing art; only the look changes (the old still is uploaded to ChatGPT as the layout reference)
no face of Jesus: from behind, hands, silhouette, light or out of frame
today shots get a diverse modern cast
neighbours: new month-one Christian films: 1 film35, 2 glass, 4 impasto, 5 vhs, 6 afrofuture, 7 cutout, 8 riso, 9 clay, 10 woodblock, 11 comic, 14 mosaic, 22 anime, 29 popcinema, 30 chrome. Closest repeat: comic on day 11 and day 17 (6 days apart).

films.suffix: neon night photography, wet streets, magenta, lime and electric-blue glow from unreadable signs, long-exposure light trails, cinematic grain, neon-noir: ancient stone streets and lanterns, but lit like a neon night photo, magenta and electric-blue glow on wet stone, deep black shadows, lime rim light
films.why: night visit, secret question, wind: a neon-noir night story
films.todayCast: a young Black man in his twenties at an open window at night over a city, notebook in hand

shots.name: BA1-Night-Street
shots.beat: Nicodemus was a respected teacher, a leader people looked up to. One night, he came to see Jesus.

shots.name: BA2-Rooftop-Talk
shots.beat: “Teacher,” he said, “we know you’ve come from God.”

shots.name: BA3-Puzzled
shots.beat: Nicodemus was baffled. “How can a grown man be born again? Can he go back into his mother’s womb?”

shots.name: BA4-The-Wind
shots.beat: Jesus said this birth is of the Spirit. “The wind blows where it wants. You hear it, but you don’t know where it comes from or where it’s going.”

shots.name: BA5-Burial-Spices
shots.beat: Nicodemus appears again near the end of John’s gospel. When Jesus died, the man who first came at night came again, carrying spices to help bury him.

shots.name: BA6-Open-Window
shots.beat: tonight, like nicodemus, bring one honest question you carry about life or faith. write it down, ask someone you trust, or, if you like, pray it. your choice.
shots.cast: a young Black man in his twenties at an open window at night over a city, notebook in hand

films.suffix: grainy 35mm film still, Kodak Portra 400 colour, natural light, visible grain and slight halation, candid documentary framing, real-looking people, push the grain and halation, harsh real daylight, gritty road-movie energy
films.why: a roadside rescue that should feel real and present, like a photo of something that just happened
films.todayCast: a South Asian woman in a rain jacket kneeling to help an older Latino man who dropped his groceries on a wet city sidewalk

shots.name: QS1-Lawyer-Asks
shots.beat: A lawyer agreed the great law was to love God and love your neighbor. Then, to test Jesus, he asked, “And who is my neighbor?”

shots.name: QS2-Road-Down
shots.beat: Jesus didn’t give a definition. He told a story. A man was going down the road from Jerusalem to Jericho, and robbers left him half dead.

shots.name: QS3-Passing-By
shots.beat: A priest came by, saw him, and passed by on the other side. Then a Levite, a temple helper, did the same.

shots.name: QS4-Samaritan-Kneels
shots.beat: Then a Samaritan, from a people many listeners mistrusted, saw him and was moved with compassion. He bandaged his wounds, pouring on oil and wine.

shots.name: QS5-Inn
shots.beat: He took him to an inn and paid for his care. “Look after him. Whatever more you spend, I’ll repay you when I return.”

shots.name: QS6-Today
shots.beat: notice one person today you’d usually walk past, a coworker, a neighbor, someone on the street, and stop for them: a hello, a hand, a coffee. that’s “go and do the same.”
shots.cast: a South Asian woman in a rain jacket kneeling to help an older Latino man who dropped his groceries on a wet city sidewalk

films.note: ChatGPT kept a golden cast; stills were graded cooler and grittier (raw kept as rp-<name>-raw.png in Downloads)

films.suffix: hand-painted 1970s cinema billboard art, oil on canvas, heroic poses, dramatic sky, saturated colour, no lettering, big heroic poses, dramatic painted skies, saturated reds and oranges, maximal drama
films.why: the biggest emotional swing of the month: party, pig sty, father running; a hand-painted cinema billboard sells it big

shots.name: C01-He-Asks
shots.beat: Jesus told a story. A young man said to his father, “Give me my share of what’s coming to me.”

shots.name: C02-The-Purse
shots.beat: So the father divided what he had.

shots.name: C03-He-Leaves
shots.beat: Not many days later, the younger son packed everything and left for a far country.

shots.name: C04-Far-Country
shots.beat: There he wasted it all on wild living.

shots.name: C05-Famine
shots.beat: Then a severe famine came over that country, and he began to be in need.

shots.name: C06-The-Pigs
shots.beat: He took a job feeding pigs. He longed to eat what the pigs ate, and no one gave him anything.

shots.name: C07-His-Senses
shots.beat: Then he came to himself.

shots.name: C08-Road-Home
shots.beat: He set off for home, practicing his speech: “Father, I have sinned. Make me one of your hired servants.”

shots.name: C09-Rooftop
shots.beat: But while he was still far off, his father saw him.

shots.name: C10-Father-Runs
shots.beat: He was moved with compassion. He ran, threw his arms around him, and kissed him.

shots.name: C11-Embrace
shots.beat: The son began his speech. The father didn’t let him finish.

shots.name: C12-Feast
shots.beat: “Bring out the best robe. Put a ring on his hand. Let’s celebrate. He was lost, and is found.”

films.suffix: Roman wall fresco, Pompeian red and ochre plaster, fine cracks in the surface, classical figures, soft faded pigment, bold Pompeian red and black panels, strong ochre and teal, crisp figures, not faded beige
films.why: Roman-era Corinth told on its own walls, in loud Pompeian red
films.todayCast: a Filipino-American teen boy quietly making breakfast for his tired younger sister in a small kitchen

shots.name: QL1-Corinth-Port
shots.beat: Corinth was a busy Greek port city. A small church there followed Jesus, rich and poor, sharing one table.

shots.name: QL2-Quarrel
shots.beat: Then the trouble started. They split into camps, “I follow Paul,” “I follow Apollos.” Some even took each other to court.

shots.name: QL3-Paul-Writes
shots.beat: Paul heard the news far away in Ephesus. He sent them a long letter. And right in the middle of it, he wrote about love.

shots.name: QL4-Letter-Read
shots.beat: “Love is patient. Love is kind. It doesn’t envy, it doesn’t boast, it isn’t proud. It keeps no record of wrongs.”

shots.name: QL5-Love-Acts
shots.beat: “It bears all things, hopes all things, endures all things. Love never fails.” Paul’s word for love was agape, the same word the Bible uses for God’s love.

shots.name: QL6-Today
shots.beat: think of one person who wears your patience thin. today, do one kind thing for them without waiting to feel like it. that’s agape.
shots.cast: a Filipino-American teen boy quietly making breakfast for his tired younger sister in a small kitchen

films.suffix: Afrofuturist art direction, luminous metallic textiles, West African pattern, cosmic light, regal composition, bold saturated colour
films.why: a father and son, a healing and the spirit; luminous, regal, cosmic light
films.todayCast: a Nigerian-British woman in her thirties at a kitchen table at night, hands folded, candle lit

shots.name: QB1-Crowd
shots.beat: A father brought his son to Jesus’s friends. Since childhood, the boy had suffered terrible fits. The friends tried to help, and couldn’t.

shots.name: QB2-Coming-Down
shots.beat: Jesus came down from a mountain into the middle of an argument. The father stepped forward: “If you can do anything, take pity on us and help us.”

shots.name: QB3-Father-Cries
shots.beat: “If you can?” said Jesus. “All things are possible for the one who believes.”

shots.name: QB4-Hand-Lifted
shots.beat: Jesus spoke, and the boy grew still. Then Jesus took him by the hand and lifted him up, and he stood.

shots.name: QB5-Some-Doubted
shots.beat: Even his closest friends wrestled with doubt. After Easter, on a mountain, the gospel says, “they worshiped him, but some doubted.”

shots.name: QB6-Today
shots.beat: if you’re carrying a doubt, don’t hide it. take the father’s five words, “i believe. help my unbelief,” and pray them, or just read them slowly tonight. watch, learn, or join in: your choice.
shots.cast: a Nigerian-British woman in her thirties at a kitchen table at night, hands folded, candle lit

films.suffix: single comic-book panel, bold inks, halftone shading, dynamic camera angles, strong flat colour, no speech bubbles, no lettering, graphic-novel inks, deep blacks, hot accent colour
films.why: David on the run: chase, cave, cry at the stars; graphic-novel drama
films.todayCast: a Mexican-American rideshare driver parked at night, head back, rain on the windshield

shots.name: QH1-Kings-Court
shots.beat: Young David played music for King Saul. But as David became loved by the people, Saul grew jealous, and turned against him.

shots.name: QH2-Wilderness-Run
shots.beat: David ran for his life. For years he lived in the wilderness, hiding in caves, with the king’s soldiers on his trail.

shots.name: QH3-Cave
shots.beat: The Bible keeps a book of songs, many linked to David, called psalms. Some were sung in the darkest times.

shots.name: QH4-How-Long
shots.beat: “How long, Lord? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?”

shots.name: QH5-Dawn-Song
shots.beat: But the same short psalm ends, “I will sing to the Lord, because he has been good to me.”

shots.name: QH6-Today
shots.beat: if something’s been eating at you, tell God straight today, out loud or on paper: “how long?” then end, as david did, with one thing that’s still good. pray it, write it, or just read psalm 13 slowly: your choice.
shots.cast: a Mexican-American rideshare driver parked at night, head back, rain on the windshield

films.suffix: stained-glass window art, jewel-toned glass panes with dark lead lines, sunbeams throwing coloured light across stone, stained-glass pop: saturated jewel colours, thick black leading, light blasting through
films.why: the cross told as stained glass, reverent and jewel-bright
films.todayCast: a Black nurse in scrubs pausing by a hospital corridor window with a small cross on the wall

shots.name: QX1-Bare-Hill
shots.beat: In the Roman world, a cross wasn’t jewelry. It was a shameful death, kept for slaves, rebels and criminals.

shots.name: QX2-Carrying
shots.beat: Jesus was sentenced to die on one. A man coming in from the country, Simon of Cyrene, was made to carry the cross behind him.

shots.name: QX3-Forgive
shots.beat: On the cross, Jesus prayed, “Father, forgive them, for they don’t know what they are doing.” Below, the soldiers threw dice for his clothes.

shots.name: QX4-Dark-Noon
shots.beat: One of the criminals beside him said, “Jesus, remember me when you come into your kingdom.” Jesus said, “Today you will be with me in paradise.”

shots.name: QX5-Women-Watch
shots.beat: Most of his disciples had fled. But the women stayed, watching from a distance, and saw where he was laid.

shots.name: QX6-Today
shots.beat: next time you see a cross today, on a church, a necklace, a wall, stop for one breath and remember “father, forgive them.” say it for someone who hurt you, or just think it: your choice.
shots.cast: a Black nurse in scrubs pausing by a hospital corridor window with a small cross on the wall

films.suffix: an expressive heavy impasto oil painting in the manner of Van Gogh: thick swirling palette-knife strokes with visible paint ridges, a deep cobalt and violet night sky breaking into blazing cadmium-yellow dawn, bold complementary colours
films.why: dawn at the tomb in thick paint: dark to blazing light
films.todayCast: a Korean-American woman in her sixties writing in a notebook on her bed in morning light

shots.name: QT1-Spices-Dawn
shots.beat: Early on Sunday, at sunrise, three women walked to Jesus’s tomb with spices. His other friends were hiding. The women came.

shots.name: QT2-Big-Stone
shots.beat: But when they looked up, the stone had already been rolled back.

shots.name: QT3-Empty-Tomb
shots.beat: Inside sat a young man in white. “Don’t be afraid. You’re looking for Jesus, who was crucified. He has risen. He is not here.”

shots.name: QT4-Mary-Weeps
shots.beat: Mary Magdalene stayed by the tomb, crying. She saw a man nearby and thought he was the gardener.

shots.name: QT5-Mary-Turns
shots.beat: Then he said one word: “Mary.” She turned, and knew him. She ran to tell the others, “I have seen the Lord!”

shots.name: QT6-Today
shots.beat: think of one worry you’re walking toward this week. write it down, and next to it write: “the stone may already be moved.” if you like, hand it to God in a one-line prayer: watch, learn, or join in.
shots.cast: a Korean-American woman in her sixties writing in a notebook on her bed in morning light

films.note: first pass came out too close to the old golden look; repainted with the stronger Van Gogh impasto suffix

films.suffix: claymation-look stop-motion set, handmade plasticine figures with visible fingerprints, miniature practical props, soft studio light, shallow depth of field
films.why: a tentmaker couple, a workshop and a home table: handmade claymation warmth
films.todayCast: a mixed group of friends in their twenties (Black, white, East Asian, Latina, one in a wheelchair) sharing a meal on a living-room floor

shots.name: QC1-Leaving-Rome
shots.beat: Priscilla and Aquila were a Jewish couple, tentmakers. When the emperor forced Jews out of Rome, they packed up and moved to Corinth.

shots.name: QC2-Tent-Workshop
shots.beat: Then Paul arrived, a tentmaker too. He lived with them, and the three of them sewed tents side by side.

shots.name: QC3-Apollos
shots.beat: In Ephesus they heard a gifted preacher, Apollos. Instead of correcting him in public, they took him aside and explained the way of God more fully.

shots.name: QC4-House-Church
shots.beat: People gathered in their home to pray and share bread. Paul wrote, “Greet the church that is in their house.”

shots.name: QC5-One-Body
shots.beat: Paul said they were like one body: eyes, hands, feet, every part needed. “You are the body of Christ.”

shots.name: QC6-Today
shots.beat: find two or three. message one or two people today and set up a meal, a walk, or a prayer together this week. that’s how the first churches started. if you already belong to a church, invite someone along.
shots.cast: a mixed group of friends in their twenties (Black, white, East Asian, Latina, one in a wheelchair) sharing a meal on a living-room floor

films.suffix: 1990s music-video VHS still, chromatic aberration, scan lines, tape noise, saturated colour, handheld low-angle energy
films.why: crowds at the river, a wild preacher, the start of the story: 90s music-video energy
films.todayCast: a teen boy of Ethiopian heritage reading a small paperback Bible at a kitchen table, mug beside him

shots.name: QJ1-Wilderness-Voice
shots.beat: The shortest of the four gospels doesn’t start with a manger. It starts, “The beginning of the good news of Jesus Christ.”

shots.name: QJ2-Crowds-River
shots.beat: Crowds came from Jerusalem and all the countryside, and he baptized them in the river.

shots.name: QJ3-Jesus-Comes
shots.beat: “Someone is coming after me who is greater than I am,” John said. Then one day Jesus came from Nazareth, and was baptized too.

shots.name: QJ4-Heavens-Torn
shots.beat: As he came up out of the water, the sky tore open and the Spirit came down on him like a dove. And a voice spoke.

shots.name: QJ5-Road-Ahead
shots.beat: From there the story runs. “Immediately” comes again and again, on a road that leads all the way to Jerusalem.

shots.name: QJ6-Today
shots.beat: start here. mark’s gospel is short enough to read in one evening. read or listen to its first chapter today, about ten minutes. watch, learn, or join in: your choice.
shots.cast: a teen boy of Ethiopian heritage reading a small paperback Bible at a kitchen table, mug beside him

films.suffix: woodblock print, carved line texture, limited flat colours, visible wood grain in the ink, strong silhouettes, bold two- and three-colour carving, strong black silhouettes, one hot red accent
films.why: a farmer, seed, birds, thorns and harvest: a carved woodblock parable
films.todayCast: a white teacher in her fifties taping an encouraging note to a student locker in a school hallway

shots.name: QW1-Boat-Shore
shots.beat: So many people came that Jesus got into a boat and sat on the water, while the crowd stood on the shore. He told them a story.

shots.name: QW2-Sower-Throws
shots.beat: “A farmer went out to sow.” He threw his seed by hand, far and wide.

shots.name: QW3-Path-And-Rock
shots.beat: Some fell on the path, and birds ate it. Some fell on rocky ground. It sprang up fast, then withered in the sun.

shots.name: QW4-Thorns
shots.beat: Some fell among thorns, and the thorns grew up and choked it.

shots.name: QW5-Harvest
shots.beat: But some fell on good soil, and brought a harvest: a hundred, sixty, or thirty times what was sown.

shots.name: QW6-Today
shots.beat: keep throwing seed. do one generous thing today with no guarantee it lands: an encouraging text, a note, a kind word to someone who might shrug it off.
shots.cast: a white teacher in her fifties taping an encouraging note to a student locker in a school hallway

films.suffix: layered paper cut-out collage, cut and torn coloured paper, visible paper fibres and soft drop shadows, handmade diorama depth, bright saturated paper colours, lime, pink and saffron
films.why: small things that grow huge: seed to tree, pinch of yeast to bread for a crowd, in paper cut-out
films.todayCast: an older Indian Christian man leaving a bag of bread on a neighbour's doorstep and walking away unseen

shots.name: QY1-Tiny-Seed
shots.beat: Jesus said the kingdom of heaven is like a mustard seed, one of the smallest seeds a farmer would plant.

shots.name: QY2-Mustard-Tree
shots.beat: But when it grows, it’s bigger than all the garden plants. It becomes a tree, and the birds come and nest in its branches.

shots.name: QY3-Woman-Kneads
shots.beat: Then another story. The kingdom is like yeast that a woman hid in three measures of flour.

shots.name: QY4-Risen-Dough
shots.beat: Three measures was a huge amount, enough bread for a crowd. A pinch of yeast, hidden inside, lifted all of it.

shots.name: QY5-Bread-Shared
shots.beat: Small, and hidden. That’s how Jesus said God’s kingdom starts.

shots.name: QY6-Today
shots.beat: small is how it starts. pick one tiny, hidden act today: a quiet kindness no one sees, a coin given, or a two-line prayer if you’d like: watch, learn, or join in. let it work like yeast.
shots.cast: an older Indian Christian man leaving a bag of bread on a neighbour's doorstep and walking away unseen

films.suffix: Mexican retablo folk painting on tin, naive figures, warm earth pigments, painted floral border with no writing, devotional sincerity, vivid tin-painted colour, bold folk outlines
films.why: a shepherd searching the hills and carrying one home: Mexican retablo devotion
films.todayCast: a Latina grandmother on her sofa smiling into a phone call

shots.name: QE1-Grumbling
shots.beat: Tax collectors and outsiders crowded around Jesus. Some religious leaders grumbled, “This man welcomes sinners and eats with them.”

shots.name: QE2-Ninety-Nine
shots.beat: So Jesus told them a story. “Which of you, with a hundred sheep, if you lose one, doesn’t leave the ninety-nine and go after the lost one?”

shots.name: QE3-Searching
shots.beat: He goes out into the wild hills, and he keeps searching until he finds it.

shots.name: QE4-Found
shots.beat: And when he finds it, he doesn’t scold it. He lays it on his shoulders, rejoicing, and carries it home.

shots.name: QE5-Rejoice
shots.beat: He calls his friends and neighbors: “Rejoice with me!” Jesus said heaven rejoices like that over one lost person who turns back to God.

shots.name: QE6-Today
shots.beat: one is worth the walk. think of one person who’s drifted, from you, from friends, from church. reach out today: a message, a call, a knock. no lecture. just “i was thinking of you.”
shots.cast: a Latina grandmother on her sofa smiling into a phone call

films.suffix: high-fashion editorial photograph, styled wardrobe, sculptural studio or location light, medium-format crispness, magazine-cover composure, dark seamless backdrop, single hard spotlight, fashion-magazine drama
films.why: one woman, one lamp, one coin: dramatic fashion-editorial light
films.todayCast: a Samoan family hugging in a kitchen as someone comes home, food on the table

shots.name: QN1-Ten-Coins
shots.beat: Right after the lost sheep, Jesus told another story. A woman had ten silver coins, each about a day’s pay. Then she lost one.

shots.name: QN2-Lamp-Lit
shots.beat: She didn’t wait for morning. She lit a lamp.

shots.name: QN3-Sweeping
shots.beat: She swept the whole house, corner by corner, and searched carefully until she found it.

shots.name: QN4-Found
shots.beat: There it was, in the dust. She held it up in the lamplight.

shots.name: QN5-Party
shots.beat: Then she called her friends and neighbors: “Rejoice with me! I’ve found the coin I lost.”

shots.name: QN6-Today
shots.beat: throw the party. when someone comes back, to church, to health, to the family, to you, celebrate it out loud today: a message, a meal, a cake. if you’d like, say a one-line thank-you prayer for them: your choice.
shots.cast: a Samoan family hugging in a kitchen as someone comes home, food on the table

films.suffix: Byzantine gold-tessera mosaic, glittering gold ground, small stone and glass tiles, flat sacred composition, blazing gold, glittering tesserae, deep cobalt and crimson
films.why: treasure and a pearl of great price: glittering gold mosaic
films.todayCast: a Chinese-Canadian woman closing her laptop and reaching for a guitar at home in the evening

shots.name: QR1-Plowing
shots.beat: Jesus said the kingdom of heaven is like treasure hidden in a field. In those days, people buried valuables to keep them safe.

shots.name: QR2-Treasure-Jar
shots.beat: A man found it. It wasn’t his field. He covered it up again.

shots.name: QR3-Selling-All
shots.beat: “Then in his joy he goes and sells everything he has, and buys that field.”

shots.name: QR4-Merchant-Pearl
shots.beat: Again: a merchant looking for fine pearls found one of great price. He sold everything he had and bought it.

shots.name: QR5-Field-Bought
shots.beat: Elsewhere Jesus said, “Where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.”

shots.name: QR6-Today
shots.beat: where your treasure is, your heart will be. look at where your time went this week. today, give one hour to what matters most to you, gladly, not out of duty.
shots.cast: a Chinese-Canadian woman closing her laptop and reaching for a guitar at home in the evening

films.note: QR5 first pass gave the farmer a halo (read as a holy figure); redone with no halo

films.suffix: two- or three-colour risograph poster print, bold flat shapes, slightly misregistered ink, halftone dots, lime and black with one accent colour, lime, black and hot pink, big flat shapes, punchy
films.why: hiring hall, heat, payday and grumbling: a punchy risograph poster
films.todayCast: two coworkers in an office, a Black woman hugging her younger Arab-American colleague who just got good news

shots.name: QV1-Dawn-Market
shots.beat: A landowner went out at dawn to hire workers for his vineyard. He agreed to pay them a denarius, the usual day’s wage.

shots.name: QV2-Vineyard-Heat
shots.beat: He went back at nine, at noon, and at three, and hired more.

shots.name: QV3-Last-Hour
shots.beat: At five, an hour before quitting time, he found others still standing around. “No one has hired us.” “You go into the vineyard too.”

shots.name: QV4-Payday
shots.beat: The ones who came at five got a full day’s pay. The ones hired at dawn were sure they’d get more.

shots.name: QV5-Grumble
shots.beat: They got the same, and grumbled: “These last worked one hour, and you made them equal to us, who bore the heat of the day!”

shots.name: QV6-Today
shots.beat: generosity isn’t fair. it’s better. today, when someone gets something you think they didn’t earn, a break, a second chance, a win, choose to be glad for them, and tell them so.
shots.cast: two coworkers in an office, a Black woman hugging her younger Arab-American colleague who just got good news

method: each old still was uploaded to ChatGPT as a layout guide and redrawn in the new look; clips rendered with scratchpad fire-rp2.sh (same motion pipeline as fire-w1.sh) to the same clip names
